verses.text: wajjahtu wajhii lahu habdan lahu abadan
zaa khidmatin lirasuulil laahi kal kubaraa
uhdii lahu bihadaa yal madhu naa filatan
wa bis salaati bihubit yuurisul kibaraa
lahu halayya liwajhil laahi laa lilaghan
duyuunu madhin taziidus sabqa wal mumuraa
qalib quluubal hidaa yaa rabbi fii humurii
linusratii wal tarud lii jumlatal umaraa
halayhi salli wa sallim bil kiraami wa hab
bihi liyal amna fid daarayni wal busharaa
dahawtukal yawma sakhkhii lil hidaa abadan
rud lil lahiina wa rud lil jinna wal basharaa
taraktu fii rajabin maa anta tahlamuhu
faltakfiniihaa wa hab lil aaya was suwara
hab lii quhudan bimaa tardaahu min hamalin
abqayta lil humra yaa man ahsanas suwaraa
